Stratified pathway-level DAA workflow for PICRUSt2 outputs

pathway_sdaa.Rd

Given a PICRUSt2 stratified table (columns sample, taxon, function, taxon_function_abun) and a phyloseq object, the function:

  1. validates overlap of samples and taxa,

  2. aggregates ASV-level contributions to a chosen taxonomic rank (taxon_level) or groups by each function,

  3. constructs wide matrices (rows = function IDs; cols = samples),

  4. filters tables to ensure at least two groups and sufficient samples,

  5. runs pathway_daa() on each table,

  6. annotates significant results using MicroFun::pathway_annotation() or result_annotation() depending on direction/pathway.

Usage

pathway_sdaa(
  stratified_path,
  physeq,
  taxon_level = "Genus",
  group,
  daa_method = "Maaslin2",
  p.adjust.method = "none",
  threshold = 0.05,
  direction = "taxa",
  pathway = "KO",
  confounders = NULL,
  reference = NULL,
  min_samples = 5,
  verbose = TRUE,
  kegg_map = NULL
)

Arguments

stratified_path

Character scalar. Path to the stratified PICRUSt2 file (tab-delimited) containing columns sample, taxon, function, and taxon_function_abun. For inputs without this abundance column, norm_taxon_function_contrib is accepted for non-KEGG analyses with a compatible DAA method.

physeq

A phyloseq object with both tax_table (ASV rows) and sample_data.

taxon_level

Character scalar. Taxonomic rank used to aggregate ASVs when direction = "taxa" (e.g., "Genus"). Must exist in phyloseq::tax_table(physeq).

group

Character scalar. Column name in sample_data(physeq) for the primary grouping variable. Coerced to factor; optionally releveled via reference.

daa_method

Character scalar. DAA backend passed to pathway_daa() (e.g., "Maaslin2", "edgeR", "DESeq2", "limma voom", "metagenomeSeq", "Lefser").

p.adjust.method

Character scalar. Multiple-testing adjustment method forwarded to pathway_daa() (e.g., "none", "BH").

threshold

Numeric. Significance cutoff used during result annotation (typically FDR/q-value threshold). Default: 0.05.

direction

Character. One of "taxa" or "function". If "taxa", ASV contributions are aggregated to taxon_level and analyzed per-taxon table. If "function", tables are built per function (KO/EC/MetaCyc) across taxa.

pathway

Character. Functional namespace of function IDs: "KO", "EC", "MetaCyc", or "KEGG". With direction = "taxa", KO input is summarized by KEGG membership, and KEGG input uses PICRUSt2 pathway contributions directly.

confounders

Optional. Confounding covariates to adjust for in DAA backends that support them. May be:

  • a character vector of column names found in sample_data(physeq),

  • a numeric/character vector (single confounder),

  • or a data.frame of covariates (one column per variable).

Note: This argument is prepared here; use depends on the selected analysis backend.

reference

Optional character. Reference level for group; if present, group is releveled accordingly.

min_samples

Integer. Require strictly more than min_samples samples (after metadata filtering) in a per-table subset to run DAA. Default: 5.

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, print progress messages. Default TRUE.

kegg_map

Optional PICRUSt2 mapping TSV or named member list passed to ko2kegg_abundance() when summarizing KO input.

Details

Build per-taxon or per-function abundance tables from a stratified PICRUSt2 file and run differential abundance analysis (DAA), with optional annotation to KEGG/EC/MetaCyc names. Supports adjusting the modeling design with confounders via backends that accept them (e.g., MaAsLin2).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
stratified_path <- "pred_metagenome_contrib.tsv"
# Minimal inputs
out <- pathway_sdaa(
  stratified_path = stratified_path,
  physeq          = physeq_obj,
  taxon_level     = "Genus",
  group           = "Group",
  daa_method      = "Maaslin2",
  p.adjust.method = "BH",
  threshold       = 0.05,
  direction       = "taxa",
  pathway         = "KO",
  confounders     = c("Age","Sex"),
  reference       = "Control",
  min_samples     = 5
)

# Function-centric EC analysis:
out_fun <- pathway_sdaa(
  stratified_path = stratified_path,
  physeq          = physeq_obj,
  taxon_level     = "Genus",
  group           = "Group",
  daa_method      = "edgeR",
  direction       = "function",
  pathway         = "EC"
)
} # }
